name: vault.export
description: Owner-only whole-vault archive or OKF bundle; includes custody secrets. ZIP import: oneiron import archive on a stopped vault. Delivery transfer returns transfer_ref for vault.export.transfer.read and vault.export.transfer.release.

docs.ts: /** Exports the whole vault as one archive (ZIP, base64 in `archive`); owner only; includes custody secrets. Load a ZIP with `oneiron import archive` while the vault is stopped; no served import verb exists. `notices` names each world it carries that the owner's recipient choice would keep from where it goes. */
docs.py: Exports the whole vault as one archive (ZIP, base64 in `archive`); owner only; includes custody secrets.
